notes.title: Performance Improvements and Much More...
notes.content:
Hello Everyone!

We're excited to share some improvements and fixes to make gameplay even better. Here's what's new:

[h2]Performance Improvements
[/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]Optimized performance overall:[/b] Experience smoother gameplay, reduced lag, and enhanced stability through optimizations in lighting, navigation, occlusion.
[/list]
[h2]Visual & Graphics Enhancements
[/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]Improved Graphics:[/b] Enjoy enhanced lighting in some parts of the game and refined visuals across the board for a more immersive experience.

[*] [b]Higher Resolutions:[/b] Now supporting [b]2K[/b] and [b]4K[/b].

[*] Added a motion blur toggle option in the menus.

[*] [b]Refined Shadows & Animations:[/b] Added real-time shadows on almost all quality levels and improved animations quality, even on lower settings.
[/list]
[h2]Audio Improvements
[/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]Immersive Sound Tweaks:[/b] Enjoy a dynamic audio experience with balanced sound volumes and effects throughout the game.
[/list]
[h2]Gameplay & Interaction Updates
[/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]Refined gameplay experience:[/b] More intuitive item placements in some areas, better cutscene transitions.

[*][b] Enhanced Enemy Vision:[/b] Improved monsters eyesight in the dark to increase the challenge and add realism to enemy encounters.
[/list]
[h2]Extra Updates & Credits
[/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]Updated Credits:[/b] Check out the refreshed credits that now include our amazing influencers (Lu_madness, OniMizu, GZA et KARO, Grejel).
[/list]

Experience the latest improvements firsthand. Explore the enhancements at your own pace.

Roger

notes.title: Version 2.0 is Here!
notes.content:
Hello again, everyone! This is the biggest update in a long time, packed with major improvements and fixes to make Krampus is Home better than ever. Whether you’re returning to the horror or diving in for the first time, now is the perfect time to experience it!

[h1]OUR NEW TRAILER[/h1]

[previewyoutube=MRNnQvJt_oU;full][/previewyoutube]

[h1]GENERAL CHANGES[/h1]
[list]
[*] Updated the logos for both Regl Studios and Krampus is Home.
[/list]
[h1]🎮 GAMEPLAY[/h1]
[list]
[*] Better Survival Experience – Enhanced level design and adjusted difficulty for a smoother gameplay experience.

[*] Jumping adjusted – Platforming is now more fair and responsive.

[*] Enhanced Interactions – Updated the interaction UI to display interactable world objects and improved inventory management for a snappier experience.

[*] Control & UI Tweaks – Changed the Inventory button from 'I' to 'Tab' for better accessibility and refined the deadzone for both the right and left sticks on controllers to prevent drifting.

[*] Flashlight & Water Gun Adjustments – The flashlight now lasts a bit longer, and the water gun has an increased ammo capacity.

[*] Speedrunning Fixes – The timer is now more precise and ensures fair calculation of gameplay experience.

[*] Improved Menu Text – Text now appears sharper and clearer for better readability.
[/list]
[h1]IMMERSIVE EXPERIENCE[/h1]
[list]
[*] Cutscene Improvements – All cutscenes have been enhanced and refined overall.

[*] Redesigned Locations – Many areas in the Krampus world have been enhanced with improved decorations and refined level layouts.

[*] Narration & Subtitles – Added new voice lines and improved subtitle timing and readability.
[/list]
[h1]⚙ TECHNICAL CHANGES[/h1]
[list]
[*] Optimized Graphics Settings – V-Sync, resolution, and display options updated.
[/list]

[h1]THE FUTURE[/h1]

We are committed to continuously improving the game and adding new features across Story, Survival, and Multiplayer modes.

If you enjoyed the update, please consider leaving a review on the store page, your feedback means a lot to us, and we’d love to hear your thoughts!


🔥 The game is also getting a DISCOUNT stay tuned!

🚀 Update now and experience the new version!

notes.title: Version 1.0.92
notes.content:
Hello everyone, we are excited to tell you about version 1.0.92, what it brings to the game and some future plans.

[b]GENERAL:[/b]

- The game has been translated to Czech.
- Fixed a problem in the main menu where it didn´t  load single player after playing multiplayer.
- Fixed a bug that didn´t allow players to select Turkish language when playing the first time.
- Fixed a bug that prevented the Krampus gift icons to not locate the human properly in certain occasions.

[b]MULTIPLAYER:[/b]

- All matches have a time limit now, the time is displayed while playing at the top of your screen.
- Added two monsters.
- New Area 500 added.
- Reduced human stamina to be more fair with the monsters in multiplayer.
- Two new achievements added.

[b]FUTURE PLANS:[/b]

- We are going to add more content to multiplayer in future updates.

- We want to add the option to complete a match with AI (Bots) inside multiplayer so that players can complete their teams without having to find real players all the time. This idea might take some time to develop but we think that it is a good way to add more playability to the multiplayer mode.

Please remember to restart Steam to be able to download the latest version of the game.

The game is now on a 50% discount until March 9th.

You can also check our ´Discord Server´ to ask us questions, find people to play with or get help from other players.

Discord server: https://discord.gg/AC4QPUS

Thank you!

notes.title: Update
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

Sorry about this piece of news, but we were unable to upload the new multiplayer update in January as promised, this is due to some bugs we are still trying to fix and also because translations are not ready yet. We are working hard to have the new version available as soon as possible within February.

The new version will have:

- Two new monsters and Area 500 in multiplayer mode.
- Improvements in performance.
- Some minor changes in enemies Artificial intelligence.

Thanks again for your support and understanding!

notes.title: Patch 1.0.85
notes.content:

Happy new year, we hope you are enjoying your holidays, this is the first of many changes that Krampus is Home will have throughout 2020:

- Controller User interface is now visible when connecting any type of controller.

- Sometimes body parts of the characters were missing during gameplay like hair and eyes, this happened specially during multiplayer, this problem has been solved.

- Fixed a bug where characters names were not being displayed.

- Fixed an issue where pressing the inventory button inside the pause menu would disable player interaction with objects in the map.

- Random crashes on windows 7 computers should be a thing of the past.

- Krampus world TVs are working again.

- Now inside ´Quick Match´ the objective and location gets randomized once the match is over.

We are still working on area 500 and a new enemy, this new content will be available this month.

You can also check our ´Discord Server´ to ask us questions, find people to play with or get help from other players.

Discord server: https://discord.gg/AC4QPUS

Thank you!

notes.title: Krampus is Home has Officially launched!
notes.content:
We are excited to announce that Krampus is Home (Version 1.0) has just transitioned out of the early access stage! The game will get more updates and improvements after this version.

This version contains:
- Full story mode.
- Survival Mode.
- Changes in the environments and characters.
- Improved performance.
- Look sensitivity can be adjusted in the menus.
- Better playability.
- More languages added.
- And much more...

If you find any issues please contact us and we will try to fix them as soon as possible. Also if you have any suggestions or opinions please let us know.

We want to thank everyone who supported us and for believing in this project.

notes.title: Official release date: 15th of March 2019!
notes.content:
Hello everyone, we are excited to announce the official release date of Krampus is Home (version 1.0) which will be this 15th of march of 2019. The final price will be $14.99 USD.

This version will include:

- The complete story mode.
- Most of the survival mode.
- Better inventory mechanics.
- Better aesthetics.
- Steam achievements.
- Look sensitivity can be adjusted in the menu.
- Various bugs fixed.

These languages will be added:

- Polish.
- Japanese.
- Italian.
- French.

Thank you for the support! If you have any suggestions please let us know.
